control_rules: Witness location is not textual access.
Multiple digitizations do not increase confidence in a reading until the target text is actually read.
OCR/searchable text and image-verified reading are separate evidence states.
A correction apparatus records intended correction while leaving the base printed body as a distinct material state.
Physical annotated copies must be treated individually, not collapsed into a singular author's copy.
